about: Central Bank of India operates as a commercial bank in India. The company offers deposit products, which include savings and current accounts, time deposits, recurring deposit schemes, and small saving scheme; and loans, including housing, vehicle, property, personal, pensioner, education, and agricultural, as well as micro small and medium enterprises loans. It also provides credit, debit, and prepaid/gift cards, as well as cash management, mutual funds, depository, mobile and Internet banking,
